prerequisites: Basic knowledge in Object-Oriented Programming and Software Engineering is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to describe what types of design and programming techniques exist and how to use them.
Students are able to understand the applications and power of these techniques.
Students are able to understand their theoretical foundations.
Students are able to compare and apply tools for programming and software analysis of real programs.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods in independently recognizing, formulating, and solving problems.
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both before an audience and in a discussion.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two of the exercise assignments. The final grade will be given on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
